tbesh_html:
Sidon = "hunting"
ancient Phoenician city, on Mediterranean coast north of Tyre
Another name of tsi.don (צִידוֹן "Sidon" H6721H)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Tsidon, the name of a son of Canaan, and of a place in Palestine
strongs_1890.derivation: or צִידֹן; from H6679 (צוּד) in the sense of catching fish; fishery;
